title: Units of measure R1: a number field declares its unit (unitConfig) and the write path checks the unit code
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Units of measure, release R1 (ADR-0158 U7). Parent: #35339. The ADR is the governing text: [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md) (merged PR #35370, 35bd36082c). Filed on seat 5's word, 2026-11-19.

## What to build
- **U4 / L3:** `unitConfig: { unitMode, unit, unitField, unitDimension }` on a `number` field. `fixed` is checked at build against U1. `record` points at a sibling `text` field holding each row's code: exact uppercase, a code and never an id, with no `master_detail` follow. The value stays a bare number.
- **U5:** an asynchronous write-path check admits a code that is in U1 or in the organization's `sys_unit` rows. It is not the `valueDomain` predicate, which stays pure.
- The key ships together with this reader (U8).

## Open items this card carries
- OI3: the codes of the new refusals (ADR-0112).
- OI9: which writes U5 judges → #35467.
- OI6, first half: whether a unit-bearing number field must declare `scale`.
- **OI8, ruled A on #35339 (「可以单独声明」):** a `text` unit field with no quantity beside it may declare itself a unit field; U5 judges it too, and it gets the picker and the backfill. This card settles the key's spelling beside `unitConfig.unitField` (a unit marker, not a fourth value domain) and amends U4 in ADR-0158.

## Blocked
Blocked-by: #35488

Waits on the unit tables card.

## Done when
`unitConfig` is declared and pinned (fixed checked at build; record pointer to a sibling text field). U5 refuses a non-member code with the OI3 code and admits a U1 code and an org code. OI9's three cases are pinned. ADR-0158 is amended.

p2 · area:data · domain:server.
